label: exploratory
purpose: M4 evidence audit (independent recomputation of every committed arm summary and contrast from the raw confirmatory outputs) and cheap exploratory confounder checks; never changes a frozen verdict
streams: no stream generated and no simulation run; reads research/experiments/EXP-NNN/{summary.json, metrics.csv, arm_summary.csv} and the git-ignored raw result.json files after checking their SHA-256 against summary.json raw_manifest
runtime: about 12 s wall-clock (11.5 s CPU), one process
outcome: Audit: all 47 raw files match their recorded SHA-256; 880 arm-summary values and 174 contrast rows recompute with zero discrepancy; all 46 revenue bootstrap intervals replay exactly with seed 20261124; no SESOI classification mismatch; EXP-002 has 8 revenue contrasts below 0 and 10 above 0 (the EXP-002 report said 7 and 11: corrected in M4). EXP-002 elasticities: the 9 values printed in the git-ignored raw report re-derive from the scenario parameters (-0.955 to -2.156). Exploratory: B1 tuning-stream decomposition shows the OCC losses in sv0.25-k1.0 and sv1.0-k2.0 come from p0 resolution (responsiveness part positive) and the DRP kappa = 1.0 losses from the responsiveness part at eta = 0.025 (all of it in sv0.5-k1.0, most in sv1.0-k1.0, about half in sv0.25-k1.0); B2 EXP-002 sv0.5-k2.0 replicates EXP-001 (differences +28.4 [-13.3, 70.2] OCC, +29.0 [-15.3, 73.4] DRP); B3 at the base cell the rules lose on 36.375% (OCC) and 32.15% (DRP) of streams, and the gain is concentrated in the top tercile of realised arrivals (OCC +1,063.5, DRP +936.0; FIX sold out in 85.5% of those streams); B4 tuning optimism is small relative to the effects.
failure_notes: First execution stopped with an IndexError because the EXP-003 base cell holds tuning only (no evaluation runs); the script now skips cells without paired runs. A second edit added tercile sell-out shares and the elasticity re-derivation; the committed JSON is from the final script.
evidence_status: audit: verification of committed evidence; B1 to B4: exploratory, not evidence for any hypothesis
